TD613 Encyclopedia — source-bound research retrieval

Entry: /encyclopedia/reference/manifest.json
Repository entry: app/encyclopedia/reference/manifest.json
Standalone entry: script#td613-reference-manifest, then script#td613-reference-directory and script#td613-reference-records (inert NDJSON).

This is a generated retrieval mirror of Research Edition 1.4, not new scientific evidence.

Supplemental 2026-10-23 research/ambiance/REST ledger (separate from canonical records): /encyclopedia/research/2026-10-23-addendum.json. Standalone: script#td613-research-addendum-20261023 and window.TD613ResearchAddendum. The 279 candidates are source-indexed proposals, not 279 new empirically established results.

1. Resolve the current Git SHA or deployment receipt independently. Read manifest.json for edition identity, corpus hash, facets, typed-edge semantics and unresolved references.
2. For an ID, fetch reference/records/{ID}.json directly. Source IDs use SRC-{original source key}. Every record retains its original object, canonical JSON pointer, explicit aliases, sources, evidence class and claim ceiling. Absent fields stay null.
3. For a concept, normalize NFKC/lowercase, tokenize Unicode words, read the term shard selected by the first character codepoint in hexadecimal (listed in manifest.term_shards). Intersect candidate IDs for AND queries, union for OR, then apply manifest facets. Read only the candidate records. Quoted phrases and exclusions can then be evaluated on their full text.
4. reference/graph.json provides typed outgoing edges and incoming reverse citations. Follow cited sources and explicit mentions. A shared source or graph route supplies bibliographic context, never mathematical implication.
5. reference/directory.json maps every ID to label, family, source keys, browser dossier route when available, exact HTML source line and SHA-256. Cite the record ID, source pointer, original research commit, hash and qualification. Current artifact commit requires its external receipt.
6. The browser/standalone read-only API window.TD613Reference supports weighted lexical/BM25 search with filters, phrases, exclusions and pagination, get, cite, neighbors, citedBy, route, context, facets, verify and export. Scores rank relevance rather than scientific quality.
7. Browser human route: /encyclopedia/#record=G-101 (example). Independent agents may obtain identical bytes yet still share one acquisition; retain evidence distinctions.

843 generated records; source payload SHA-256 ff0c98f564c9157f22b8603a20ddefa3ca13d843b17bdfb7e2a495408a49b4c9.
Source records can point to private Library artifacts or missing measurements; a locator alone grants no access or observation credit.
